text:
Maria: quick heads-up — for the new quantized tiny model bring-up we need to refresh the prompt pool and golden set. can we align on sampling + dedupe rules? :eyes:
Vikram: +1. do we have target workloads? latency vs quality tradeoffs will affect sampling (short vs long prompts).
Maria: primary: customer chat, code-assist, and FAQ summarization. secondary: classification and embeddings checks. focus on chat and code for phase 1.
Jonah: for dedupe, can we use fuzzy hashing + exact ngram overlaps? last sweep used jaccard > 0.85 and a quick embed-sim filter. still saw near-duplicates.
Tess: labeler team prefers batched buckets by domain and prompt length. small prompts (<50 tokens) go to latency eval, longer ones for generation quality. that helped on previous relabel.
Maria: good. propose stratify by domain x length x category (intent vs open-gen). target 2k prompts for golden candidate, 5k for broader eval.
Vikram: timeline? we want to run quant smoke + 8-bit tests next week. need golden annotated by Fri.
Tess: labeler-bot: assigning 6 labelers, estimate 3 days for golden consensus if we do 3-way labeling + adjudication.
labeler-bot: auto: created job qbringup-golden-182668, 6 labelers, consensus policy: majority -> if no majority flag for adjudicator. link: https://labeler.internal/jobs/qbringup-golden-182668
Jonah: interrater agreement threshold? last time we accepted Kripp alpha >= 0.7. should we tighten for this bring-up?
Maria: let's keep 0.7 baseline, but target 0.75 for chat intents. if below, resample ambiguous prompts and expand context.
Vikram: for dedupe pipeline, propose two passes: 1) token-level fingerprint (minhash), 2) semantic cluster prune using embed-kmeans (cosine > 0.92 remove). keep deterministic seed.
Tess: also flag template-like prompts (e.g., "Write an email about X") — those inflate counts and hurt diversity. add a simple regex filter to mark templates for low priority.
Jonah: can we add an adversarial holdout set for checks? small curated set that historically trips quant models (long reasoning chains, arithmetic, code edge cases).
Maria: yes — we'll keep a 200-example adversarial golden subset, separate label pass with strict adjudication.
Vikram: sampling SQL for the pool (sketch):
```
SELECT * FROM prompts
WHERE domain IN ('chat','code','faq')
AND token_count BETWEEN 5 AND 1024
AND is_template = false
ORDER BY rand_seed(domain, token_bucket) /* deterministic */
LIMIT 7000;
```
Jonah: looks good. for embedding dedupe run: generate d-vecs with baseline embedder then cluster with single-link at 0.92 threshold.
Tess: tagging: add metadata fields: orig_source, domain, token_count, template_flag, curator_id, label_job_id. helps audit.
Maria: operational items: 1) Vikram to share dedupe pipeline PR today. 2) Tess to spin label job and share ETA. 3) Jonah to create adversarial holdout list. 4) I'll own final golden merge + rollout gating.
Vikram: I'll drop PR link by EOD and include config for minhash params.
Tess: label job created, first batch assigned in 1h. ETA for majority pass: Thu noon PST.
Jonah: I'll push adversarial list to the repo and ping for review.
Maria: perfect. if any blocker ping #eng-ml-oncall and tag me. thanks all :rocket:
